I have one correction before approving the plan: “read later” should not be mutually exclusive with “archived.”

Read later is the bookmark’s read/unread status, while archived controls whether it is hidden from the normal lists. If I archive an unread bookmark and later restore it, it should still be unread and return to the read-later view. Restoring it “unchanged” must not silently turn it into an ordinary active bookmark.

Please adjust the plan and stored information so archived status and read/unread status are independent. The rest of the approach looks right.

Confirmation is enforced by the UI. - 204 on success. ## State & bulk actions ### POST /api/bookmarks/:id/state Set state / read flag (FR-016, FR-017). - Body: `{ "state?": "active"|"read_later"|"archived", "isRead?": boolean }`. - 200: updated bookmark. ### POST /api/bookmarks/bulk Apply one action to many bookmarks (FR-019, FR-020). - Body: ```json { "select": { "ids": [1,2,3] } // OR select all matching current filter: // { "state": "active", "q": "...", "includeTags": [...], "excludeTags": [...] }, "action": { "type": "addTags"|"removeTags"|"markRead"|"markUnread"|"archive"|"restore"|"delete", "tags": ["work"] // for addTags/removeTags } } ``` - 200: `{ "affected": number }`. Autocomplete existing tags while typing (FR-012). - 200: `{ "tags": string[] }`. ## Saved views ### GET /api/views - 200: `{ "views": SavedView[] }`. ### POST /api/views Create a named view (FR-014). - Body: `{ "name", "query?", "includedTags?": string[], "excludedTags?": string[] }`. - 201: created view. ### PATCH /api/views/:id / DELETE /api/views/:id Edit or delete a saved view (FR-014).
